name: privilege_test_access_signin
description: S5a unit 01: sign-in, lock, unlock, Switch user and the desktop through the real routes, before any S5a engine edit.

scenario.scenario_brief:
TEST: Access model sign-in

A test floor for sign-in PCs (ACCESS_MODEL_PLAN.md, step 8). Eight beats, each with a sign. S1: the hot desk (north) shows a tile for every account; sign in as Sam with the password on its sticky note. S2: the known-people PC (south) shows only people you have met; visit finance (east of the IT office) and look again. S3: Ian's PC (in the IT office, east) takes a typed username and admits IT staff only; his password is in his desk drawer. S4: Switch user at the hot desk to Ian; his files follow him. S5: copy one of Ian's files and move another. S6: open the archive with the handbook's password, then sign out. S7: the lockout PC (west) locks a username out after five wrong passwords. S8: reload; Ian's session at his PC survives.
scenario.endGoal: Test only: run the eight sign-in beats.

contents.text:
Staff handbook (test floor).

Every staff account sees this handbook on any PC it signs in to.

contents.observations: A saved copy of the staff mailbox. Nothing new.

contents.observations: Ian's on-call rota.

objectives.title: Run the sign-in beats
objectives.description: Test only. Each task ticks when its beat's sign-in event fires.

tasks.title: S1: sign in as Sam at the hot desk
S2: the known-people PC shows Lena only after you have met her
S3: sign in to Ian's PC
S4: switch the hot desk to Ian
S5: copy the rota and move the VPN notes
S6: open the archive, then sign out of the hot desk
S7: a lockout at the lockout PC, then Ian signs in there
S8: after a reload, Ian's PC opens without a password

objects.name: Sign: Start here
objects.text:
Eight sign-in beats. Hot desk north (S1, S4, S5, S6), known-people PC south (S2), IT office east (S3, S8), lockout PC west (S7).
Finance is through the IT office. Each beat room has its own sign.
objects.observations: A sign on a stand by the front desk.

objects.name: Hot desk PC
objects.observations: A shared hot desk PC. Anyone with an account can sign in here.

objects.name: Sign: S1 Account tiles
objects.text:
S1. The hot desk shows a tile for Sam, Ian and Lena, plus Other user. A wrong password for Sam says Incorrect username or password, 4 attempts left.
Sam's password is on the sticky note on the screen. Signing in shows Sam's desktop: the staff handbook and mail, none of Ian's files.
objects.observations: A sign by the hot desk.

objects.name: Sign: S4 One profile, two PCs, and switching
objects.text:
S4 (after S3). On Sam's desktop, Switch user, then Ian's tile. A wrong password leaves Sam signed in.
Ian's password signs him in instead, and the hot desk then shows the same files of Ian's as his own PC.
objects.observations: A sign by the hot desk.

objects.name: Sign: S5 Copy and Move
objects.text:
S5. Signed in as Ian, copy Server rota.txt: it stays listed, here and on Ian's PC. Move VPN notes.txt: it leaves both PCs.
Licence keys.csv offers Copy only.
objects.observations: A sign by the hot desk.

objects.name: Sign: S6 Locked folder and sign out
objects.text:
S6. Still signed in as Ian, open Old configs.zip with the password in the staff handbook.
Then Sign out: the desktop closes with Signed out, and the next click shows the sign-in screen.
objects.observations: A sign by the hot desk.

objects.name: Known-people PC
objects.observations: This PC lists only the people you have come across.

objects.name: Sign: S2 Known people only
objects.text:
S2. Open this PC before you have been to finance: no tile for Lena. Cancel.
Visit finance (through the IT office, east side), come back and open it again: Lena's tile is there.

objects.name: Ian's PC
objects.observations: Ian's workstation. It asks for a username: no account tiles.

objects.name: Ian's desk drawer
objects.observations: Ian's desk drawer. It isn't locked.

contents.name: Note: my sign-in
contents.text:
ishaw / Patchday!2026
(don't tell security)
contents.observations: A scrap of paper in Ian's handwriting.

objects.name: Sign: S3 Typed username and the access list
objects.text:
S3. Ian's PC has no tiles: type a username. Sam's correct details say This account can't sign in on this PC (IT staff only).
Ian's details are in his desk drawer. They open his desktop: the staff handbook and his own files.

objects.name: Sign: S8 Reload
objects.text:
S8. With Ian signed in here, reload the page. His PC then opens his desktop with no password, and the S3 task stays done.
Sam is still locked out at the lockout PC.

objects.name: Lockout PC
objects.observations: A PC under the corporate policy: five wrong passwords lock a username out here.

objects.name: Sign: S7 Lockout
objects.text:
S7. Five wrong passwords for Sam count down, then This account is locked on this PC. Sam's right password gets the same answer.
An invented username gets the same sequence. Ian still signs in here, and Sam still signs in at the hot desk.
objects.observations: A sign by the lockout PC.

body.endGoal: Test only: run the eight sign-in beats.
